name: German Federal Environmental Foundation (DBU): Fellowship Programme with CEE Countries
summary: The DBU awards up to 50 fellowships per year for advanced qualification in all fields of environmental protection and nature conservation. Highly qualified graduates of all disciplines from the countries of Central and Eastern Europe (CEE)
